candidates.name: Chemchemal-Bazian Gas Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Pearl Petroleum (Dana Gas / Crescent Petroleum) with unnamed private-sector pipeline builders
candidates.to: Bazian industrial area (Mass, Bazian, Delta, Gasin, Sulaimani cement plants)

evidence.note: Official Crescent Petroleum press release: gas sales agreements for up to 142 MMscf/d from Chemchemal for 10 years starting H2 2027; 'a dedicated 40-kilometer pipeline linking the Chemchemal field directly to industrial consumers in the Bazian area' to be built by private-sector companies; $160m committed for 3 wells + EWT facility + enabling infrastructure.
Independent trade-press coverage of the same GSAs, confirming the 142 MMscf/d offtake, H2 2027 start, and new private-sector pipelines to Bazian and Erbil.

Analysis piece confirming Chemchemal development (Dana Gas/Crescent/Pearl consortium) with 'a dedicated 40-kilometre pipeline' connecting Chemchemal to the Bazian industrial area, deliveries from H2 2027.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No Chemchemal-sourced pipeline exists in the roster. Nearest roster entries are P6823 Khormor-Pirdawood PP (Khor Mor-sourced, operating, feeds Chemchemal/Bazian POWER plants) and P4047 Khormor-Erbil - this is a distinct, newly announced 40 km line originating at the Chemchemal FIELD and serving Bazian INDUSTRIAL customers (cement), first announced with the Jan 2026 GSAs.

candidates.name: Chemchemal-Erbil industrial gas supply pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Private-sector companies (per Pearl Petroleum partners' announcement); offtaker Van Steel Company, Erbil

evidence.note: Press release states 'new pipelines are to be built by private-sector companies to supply gas to industrial users in Erbil and Bazian' - i.e., a second build serving the Erbil offtaker (Van Steel), in addition to the dedicated 40 km Bazian line. No route/length given.
Corroborates that new private-sector pipelines will supply industrial users in both Erbil and Bazian ahead of H2 2027 first gas.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Weaker sibling of the Bazian line: announced only as 'new pipelines... to supply gas to industrial users in Erbil'. Could conceivably be a tie-in delivering via the existing/under-construction Khor Mor-Erbil corridor (P4047) rather than a standalone Chemchemal-Erbil line - consolidator should decide; no roster entry covers a Chemchemal-to-Erbil industrial supply line.

candidates.name: Miran gas field export pipeline (to Bazian power plant)
candidates.sponsor: Miran Energy (HKN Energy + ONEX Group JV) with KRG Ministry of Natural Resources
candidates.to: Bazian power plant (per MEES; initial domestic phase)

evidence.note: MEES (paywalled beyond headline/standfirst): Miran partners fast-tracking a 100 MMcf/d gas processing plant with first gas 2H 2027; the gas to feed the nearby Bazian power plant - implying a new evacuation pipeline from Miran.

19 May 2025 Washington signing: HKN Energy + ONEX form Miran Energy JV with KRG to develop the ~8 tcf Miran field in phases, initial focus on domestic supply. Pipeline not yet specified in this source.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Early-stage lead: the field development contract is firm (May 2025, ~$40bn program, first gas targeted 2H 2027) but the pipeline itself is only implied (gas must move ~30-40 km from Miran to the Bazian power plant; MEES names Bazian PP as the destination). No Miran-related pipeline exists anywhere in the roster. Emit for tracking; specs (length/diameter/route) not yet public.
